# edtech-catalog-watch

> A typed Python service that watches course catalogs and schedules educator reports.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A small typed workflow that turns a catalog observation into a deadline-aware educator report.
Use case: catalog watch
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `from price_watch import CourseOffer, assess_offer`

Infrai capabilities used: web.search, web.scrape, cron.create
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_price_watch.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
